880-6754-8345.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-6754-8345.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-8095-8329--225.easyPrerequisites: The Zombie Cat doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and has base toughness 2 or greater.
6972-8095-8329--225.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the Zombie Cat.
When the Zombie Cat dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Zombie Cat enters, Olag and Miau's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat.
Resolve the second trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on either a Zombie or Cat you control.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.
6972-8095-8329--225.notes: You can use either Olag and Miau trigger to put a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat. The other ability can put the counter on any Zombie or Cat you control depending on which trigger is left.

1981-2415-2842-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Blood Artist and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

512-5457-7014.easyPrerequisites: Selvala and North Pole Patrol do not have summoning sickness.
512-5457-7014.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping North Pole Patrol and Selvala, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-5457-7014.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Selvala's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

728-1385-1981-2415.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

851-4365-6441-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2350-5078-6666.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Stone Calendar.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

5940-7683.notablePrerequisites: You have another instant or sorcery card in hand with the mana to cast it and applicable target(s) if needed.
5940-7683.description:
Cast any other instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Return the Favor by paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Return the Favor's storm ability triggers, creating at least one copy of Return the Favor targeting the original Return the Favor.
Resolve a copy of Return the Favor, copying Return the Favor targeting the original Return the Favor.
Repeat step 4.

3043-4091-7791.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with defender.
3043-4091-7791.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Axebane Guardian.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Axebane Guardian.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

204-392-1858-2056-7730.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-392-1858-2056-7730.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Birgi and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

requires.n: Land with Cycling Cost that can be paid using one colored mana

717-2628-7206--38.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more creatures.
717-2628-7206--38.description:
Activate the land's cycling ability by paying {1} and discarding it.
When you cycle the land, Escape Protocol and Bone Miser's second ability trigger.
Resolve Bone Miser's ability, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability, paying {1} to blink Dundoolin Weaver.
When Dundoolin Weaver enters, it triggers, returning the cycled land from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, drawing a card.
717-2628-7206--38.notes: You can discard down to maximum hand size at end of turn to trigger Bone Miser's abilities many times.

3991-5256-6132.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

224-1846-6618-6657-6820.easyPrerequisites: You control an Island that enters the battlefield untapped.
224-1846-6618-6657-6820.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Cast Relm's Sketching by paying its mana cost, targeting an Island you control.
Holding priority, activate Overloaded Mage-Ring by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, targeting the Relm's Sketching spell.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying the Overloaded Mage-Ring ability, targeting the Relm's Sketching spell.
Resolve the copy of Overloaded Mage-Ring's ability, copying the Relm's Sketching spell, targeting an Island you control that enters the battlefield untapped.
Resolve the copy of Relm's Sketching, creating a token copy of the targeted Island.
When the Island token enters, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Gogo.
Activate the Island token by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 4.

1563-2457-5223-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

560-2034-3188-4593.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Social Climber triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
560-2034-3188-4593.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

3781-4191-5256--122.description:
Cast the Insect from your hand or graveyard by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Insect.
When the Insect dies, Zask triggers.
Holding priority, cast the Insect from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Resolve the Zask ability, causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 2.

4321-5777-6716.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one Food token.
4321-5777-6716.description:
Activate Glimmer Bairn by sacrificing a Food token.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Glimmer Bairn ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

4050-6188-6591--85.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
4050-6188-6591--85.description:
Declare Squall and Fear of Missing Out as attackers.
Fear of Missing Out's second ability triggers, untapping Squall and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Fear of Missing Out.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Squall, triggering Squall's second ability, returning Fear of Missing Out from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fear of Missing Out enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to rummage.
Repeat each combat phase.

5315-5365-5445.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue.
Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Lonis.
5315-5365-5445.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis' second ability and Tarrian's Soulcleaver trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Tarrian's Soulcleaver trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

71-307-2792.notablePrerequisites:
Mukotai Ambusher and Great Whale do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Mukotai Ambusher or Great Whale.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{B}.
71-307-2792.description:
Declare Great Whale and Mukotai Ambusher as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Mukotai Ambusher from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is tapped and attacking.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Mukotai Ambusher's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{B} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Mukotai Ambusher onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Great Whale tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

549-1651-4917.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing a creature, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two Treasure tokens, untapping Jan Jansen.
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure token, creating two 1/1 Construct creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two Construct tokens, untapping Jan Jansen.
Repeat.

1168-1651-1737-2119.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Seat of the Synod.
The Seat of the Synod token enters the battlefield, triggering Toggo, creating a Rock artifact equipment token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Seat of the Synod token and the Rock token, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

202-253.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is zero or less.
202-253.description:
Activate Soul Conduit by paying {6} and tapping it, causing your life total to be swapped with target opponent's life total.
Lich causes your life total to stay the same, and instead draw cards equal to the opponent's life total when Soul Conduit resolved.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

618-813-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages with haste.
The token copy of Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, returning Time Walk and any second instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
